title: Online doctor consultation
what: A talk with a doctor by video or chat. The doctor asks questions, looks at your test results, and gives advice.
why: To discuss results, get a second opinion, adjust treatment, or find out if you need an in-person visit.
tell_doctor: What bothers you, and since when

prepare.title: Connection
prepare.text: Check your internet, phone battery, camera, and microphone.

prepare.title: Place
prepare.text: Find a quiet, well-lit place where you will not be interrupted.

prepare.title: Documents
prepare.text: Upload or photograph your test results and reports in advance.

bring: Test results and reports on your phone or computer
A thermometer or blood pressure monitor, if the doctor asked
steps: You join by the link at the set time
The doctor introduces themselves and asks about your symptoms
You show your test results, and sometimes the sore area on camera
The doctor explains what they think
They give advice or suggest an in-person visit
A written summary is usually sent to you
feel: The doctor cannot examine you by hand, so sometimes an in-person visit is needed
after: If you get worse, go for an in-person visit
What can be prescribed online depends on the country's rules
red_flags: Chest pain, severe shortness of breath, or weakness in an arm or the face: do not wait for the consultation. Call emergency services

faq.q: Can an online doctor make a diagnosis?
faq.a: It depends on the country's rules. Often the doctor gives advice, and an exact diagnosis is made in person.
Rejoin by the same link, or message the clinic's support.

reminders.text: Online consultation in an hour. Check your internet, and have your test results and questions ready.
